> 老聃之役有庚桑楚者，偏得老聃之道，以北居畏壘之山。

Among Laozi's 役 — his serving students — one is 庚桑楚, and he got the way 偏: partially.

## The limit is stated first

偏得: obtained in part.

The book puts a ceiling on the man before the story starts. That matters, because everything that follows is a success story, and the limit is what makes it readable.

## 畫然知者 and 挈然仁者, and who stays

畫然: distinct, drawn out, on display. 挈然: lifted up, held aloft.

Two kinds of people he keeps at a distance: the ones with knowledge written on their faces, and the ones carrying benevolence in their hands.

Then who stays: 擁腫之與居，鞅掌之為使 — the bloated and clumsy to live with, the harried and unkempt to work for.

擁腫 and 鞅掌 are the least flattering words in the book for plainness. That is precisely the point: this is the one place where the unpolished is not praised and not pitied, only lived with.

## 日計之而不足，歲計之而有余

Count by the day and there is not enough. Count by the year and there is surplus.

The villagers say this about him after three years of good harvest. It is the most exact accounting of slow work anywhere in the book — and note that both halves are true. By the day, it really is not enough.

## 尸而祝之，社而稷之

They want to set him up as a shrine, make him a god of soil and grain.

And his response: 南面而不釋然 — sitting in the seat of honor, and not at ease. Being installed is the failure mode, and he feels it before he can explain it.

## 天道已行矣

The way of heaven has already been walking. 天道已行矣: there is no share of it that is mine.

This is the sentence that undoes the whole success: the harvest happened, and the credit was assigned to the nearest cause, which happened to be him.

## 尸居環堵之室

尸居: still as a tablet. 環堵: a room walled on four sides, one fathom across.

The image of the correct position after being praised: not a lecture on humility. A small room, and stillness.

## 杓: the ladle handle is the target

杓 is the handle of a ladle, and by extension the mark, the thing aimed at.

我其杓之人邪 — am I the kind of man who serves as a target? Not "am I being used." Am I the sort of thing that stands where the arrow is pointed.

The disciples' logic follows: the place is too small for you, a ditch is not enough water, a low hill is not enough height. His answer is that a small place is exactly what one should be in, because 天道 has no need for a monument.

## The test

Take one result you are proud of and ask two questions from this chapter: in it, how much was 天道已行 — already underway without you? And are you currently 杓, the thing others aim at and cite? The second is flattering and it is also a position, and positions can be inherited by whoever comes next.
